g.text: PR #2483 · Hold phone pushes while any of the user's devices is in use
Working in one session on a laptop still buzzed the phone for every other one;
now any device in active use holds pushes, and an unused open tab still does not.
BEFORE
Browser lease (session_attention_views)
Renewed only while that conversation is visible,
focused, unobstructed and scrolled to its end.
push_suppressed: same session_id only
Laptop on session A, session B finishes:
the phone buzzes although you are at the laptop.
Same session, slightly scrolled up
Or a dialog open, or another window focused:
the lease lapses and the phone buzzes anyway.
AFTER
Presence lease: device in active use
Visible, focused tab with input in the last
ACTIVE_WINDOW_MS (3 minutes), any session.
push_suppressed: any live lease for user
The laptop shows replies in its Ready list.
Phone stays quiet until you step away.
Unused open tab: no input, lease expires
Within 15 seconds, so it never silences the phone.
Read receipts still need the reply on screen.
The active device gets no desktop notification instead; it relies on its in-page Ready list and banners.
